scope: Rendered ep05; internal visual review, not user casting/adoption or Instagram publication.
observations: The five scene changes preserve the run → time check → queue reveal → pun → shared white rice cakes story.
Compact Jango body, gloves/watch, woman bun/running outfit and three-cakes-to-two-plus-one continuity remain visible.
All six lettering states are legible at 360x640. Dialogue and brand stay fixed while art zooms 100–103%.
Scene 4 woman question lasts 2.3 seconds and Jango reply lasts 3.7 seconds; closing brand and one question remain for 4 seconds.
First dialogue is visible at frame zero. Whole scene frames fill the 9:16 canvas; no added letterbox bars.
Balloon tails face the appropriate speaker side and do not cover faces, the watch or rice cakes in reviewed start/mid/end frames.

The conservative control-overlay simulation keeps dialogue, eyes, mouths, the watch and the closing question clear. Some peripheral mitten/character-edge pixels lie near the right-side control column; no core action is hidden in this simulation.
Central square and 3:4 cover crops retain both title lines and Jango face. Cover is separately typeset, not a random video frame.
